title: Rabbi Inya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Gittin, chapter 1, halakhah 5, folio 6b, speaking in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. Hyman also cites Kohelet Rabbah 9:9 for Rabbi Yudan speaking in Rabbi Inya’s name.

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 1:5 supports Inya reporting Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman’s additional Kohelet Rabbah 9:9 occurrence remains unlocated in the returned research; the historical 6b folio belongs to the Jerusalem Talmud citation.

In the Jerusalem Talmud Gittin passage, Inya reports Yochanan’s requirement for a written document when freeing Tavi. In the Bava Batra 8:8 parallel, Chiyya reports Yochanan. Hyman’s Kohelet Rabbah reference has a possible counterpart in the second exposition of “Solomon had a vineyard” in Song of Songs Rabbah (8:10:2 in the consulted edition). Kadari’s transcription of the first Constantinople printing names Inya there, and the Tsofen edition quotes Inyi. The consulted digital text and the parallel in Pesikta de-Rav Kahana 5:3 name Aivu. The edition behind Hyman’s citation remains uncertain.
